name: context-bank
description: Context Bank: a borderless local window that banks every Claude Code session on this PC, searches them, and imports them into any Claude account so Claude can pick up where it left off.

scripts.dist:win: npm run pack:win && electron-builder --win portable --x64 && node -e "const z=require('child_process');process.platform==='win32'?z.execSync('powershell Compress-Archive -Force \"dist/Context Bank-win32-x64\" dist/ContextBank-win64.zip'):z.execSync('cd dist && zip -qr ContextBank-win64.zip \"Context Bank-win32-x64\"')"
